subject: Dedicated pricing: single-tenant isolation premium and throughput commitments
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechcorp.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Dedicated single-tenant isolation — ballpark pricing & throughput

Markus / team,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. FinTechCorp is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for our production inference tier and we need a concise pricing view for our commercial team. High-level ask below — a single-slide ballpark is fine to start.

What we care about:
- Single-tenant (private) GPU pool with per-customer isolation (no multi-tenant co-tenancy) — includes dedicated control plane and audit logging.
- KMS options: standard cloud KMS vs. HSM-backed KMS (we may have an HSM requirement for a subset of keys).
- Throughput guarantees and p99 latency targets for a 50k tokens/sec steady-state workload (peak bursts to 120k tokens/sec).
- Reserved commit options (12/24/36 mo) and associated discounts.
- Expected isolation premium (%, one-time onboarding vs. annual).

Constraints: SOC2 + PCI scope, EU data residency for a subset of workloads (we'll flag region later), procurement will need line-item pricing.

Can you send: (a) a concise pricing matrix showing GPU pool sizing (small/med/large), estimated throughput per config, isolation premium for each KMS option, and (b) any standard discounts for committed terms?

Also copy procurement: procure@fintechcorp.com for the formal quote.

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
VP Engineering — Platform
FinTechCorp

Attachment: FinTech_Requirements_summary.docx (DOCX, 78KB)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Dedicated single-tenant isolation — ballpark pricing & throughput

Alice — thanks for the clear list. Putting the high-level matrix below; I attached a 1-pager quote for quick internal review (Redwood_Dedicated_0421_Quote.pdf).

Ballpark pricing matrix (monthly list price, USD):
- Small pool (4 x A40-equivalent GPU) — baseline throughput ~15k tokens/sec — $45,000/mo
- Medium pool (12 x A40) — baseline throughput ~45k tokens/sec — $130,000/mo
- Large pool (24 x A40) — baseline throughput ~95k tokens/sec — $245,000/mo

Isolation premiums (applied on top of list price):
- Dedicated control plane + audit logging: +18% (annual surcharge)
- Cloud KMS integration (customer-managed keys): +6%
- HSM-backed KMS (FIPS/HSM): +22% (requires vendor KMS onboarding + separate HSM fee)
- If both audit logging + HSM: applied additively (example: baseline * 1.18 * 1.22) — we can also present a blended single surcharge.

Committed discounts (applied to base list price before isolation premiums):
- 12 mo: 7%
- 24 mo: 14%
- 36 mo: 20%

Example (medium pool, 24 mo commit + audit logging + cloud KMS):
Base: $130k/mo * (1 - 0.14) = $111.8k/mo; after audit (+18%) + cloud KMS (+6%) => ~$140k/mo.

Operational notes / flexibility:
- Pilot/POC: 3-month pilot at list price with a one-time onboarding credit we typically extend (up to $25k) if you convert to a reserved commit within 60 days.
- Burst capacity: included burst up to 30% for short windows; sustained burst requires temporary add-on or higher-sizing.
- Throughput SLA: we can commit to throughput bands (e.g., 45k steady-state for medium) with passive monitoring and runbook commitments; monetary SLAs require reserved commit + dedicated infra and are scoped per-deal.

I've looped Marissa for commercial terms. If you confirm target pool (sounds like medium ➜ large depending on actual traffic), Diego can size token QPS and buffer for KV cache/sequence-lengths.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Dedicated_0421_Quote.pdf (PDF, 46KB)

From: Procure Team <procure@fintechcorp.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Dedicated single-tenant isolation — ballpark pricing & throughput

Markus / Marissa,

Procurement here. Thanks — we need a more granular line-item breakout to feed our internal approval flow. Please provide:
- Line items for: compute (GPU pool), network egress, control plane isolation fee, audit log retention (30/90/365 days options), KMS line (cloud KMS vs HSM; if HSM include recurring HSM rent + onboarding).
- P99 latency targets and how you measure (artifact / monitoring link).
- Proposed penalty language for missed throughput SLA (we will request a credit schedule tied to % degraded throughput or downtime).
- Start-of-contract onboarding effort (estimated migration hours) and any professional services charges.

Also, can you confirm whether isolation premium is charged monthly or billed as an annual uplift? We prefer monthly amortization tied to the committed term.

Procurement will need the quote in an itemized spreadsheet (one row per SKU) and a DocuSign link for signature-ready SOW.

Regards,
FinTechCorp Procurement
procure@fintechcorp.com

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Procure Team <procure@fintechcorp.com>, Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Dedicated single-tenant isolation — ballpark pricing & throughput

Procurement — thanks, this is helpful. Attached is an itemized workbook (Dedicated_Prices_0421.xlsx) with: per-GPU compute SKU, baseline throughput estimates, audit-log retention tiers, KMS options (cloud vs HSM with one-time onboarding + monthly HSM rent), and network egress estimates.

Quick answers inline:
- Isolation premium billing: monthly amortization as an uplift on the base SKU (we can also do upfront annual billing if required by accounting).
- P99 latency: we measure request completion time end-to-end at the service edge. Typical p99 for medium pool under baseline: ~220-300ms (model dependent). For strict p99 targets we size additional headroom and include warm KV caches. SLA-grade p99 and throughput guarantees require reserved commit + dedicated redundancy (we include an SLA addendum in the SOW).
- Penalty language: standard approach is service credit tied to availability/throughput bands. Example: if sustained throughput < 90% of guaranteed for >30 min then 10% credit of monthly committed fee for that incident (capped at 100% of monthly fee/year). We can adjust bands/credits per negotiation.
- Onboarding: typical migration & onboarding is 80-160 engineer hours depending on model surface area; we offer a one-time onboarding credit (we proposed $25k in the 1-pager). Additional PS billed hourly (line item included).

Commercial proposal we prefer: 3-mo pilot (convert window 60 days) -> 24-mo reserved commit (blended discount 14%) -> isolation premium blended to 28% for HSM + audit logging (we applied additive math above). We will include two weeks of free burst capacity in month one to smooth cutover.

Links: itemized workbook + SOW draft: https://redwood.app/deals/RW-FT-2027-0422/workbook and DocuSign: https://docusign.net/XYZ-123-FT

Attachment: Dedicated_Prices_0421.xlsx (XLSX, 72KB)

Marissa / Diego / Neha — please advise if the isolation premium looks ok from a compliance/technical perspective; Diego, can you validate throughput sizing assumptions for 50k sustained / 120k burst?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechcorp.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, procure@fintechcorp.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Dedicated single-tenant isolation — ballpark pricing & throughput

Markus / team — thanks for the detailed workbook and clear answers. A few quick follow-ups from us before we move to internal approvals:

1) Isolation premium — 28% blended for HSM + audit is higher than FinTechCorp target. Can Redwood do 20% flat blended premium if we take a 36-mo commit and accept the onboarding credit? That shifts economics in our favor for longer-term partnership.

2) Throughput SLA — we need a contractual throughput guarantee for 50k tokens/sec steady-state with 99.9% availability and a clearly defined credit schedule. The example penalty language you provided is a starting point; procurement will propose exact bands but we expect firm measurables. Please confirm Redwood can commit and we can scope the SLA addendum.

3) Compliance artifacts — please attach SOC2 Type II report and a sample audit log export (redacted). Also provide KMS attestation details for HSM option (vendor name, certs).

If Redwood can accept 36-mo at 20% premium and firm SLA for 50k/99.9% with a standard credit table, we will expedite internal approval and aim to sign within 10 business days.

Alice Monroe
VP Engineering — Platform
FinTechCorp
